description: Adapt the renderer UI for Windows conventions: native window controls (min/max/close buttons), proper font rendering (Segoe UI as system font fallback), DPI-aware layout, dark/light mode following Windows system theme (via nativeTheme), smooth window resize, and taskbar progress indicator during recording/export. Ensure the dark UI works correctly with Windows 10 and 11 title bars.
title: Windows UI/UX adaptations
